prompt: What is the name of the man buried at Paddington Cemetery in London in 1767, with an epitaph that reads, "Tho' sweet as Orpheus thou couldst bring / Soft pleadings from the trembling string"?
answer:
The man was **John Lenton**, a musician, who was buried at Paddington in 1767. His epitaph included the lines:

> “Tho’ sweet as Orpheus thou couldst bring  
> Soft pleadings from the trembling string…”
